document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Sneaking around through the lifeless waste is easy to do, but the 
winds and cold cut through like knives. There is nowhere warm 
to hide. You decide to return and either hand yourself in or try 
to gain the team’s confidence, go to 510.
(510)
